This file is a trimmed merge of: - protocol/tizen/wtz-shell.xml (full) - protocol/tizen/wtz-screen.xml (just `wtz_screen`, no splitscreen) from the Tizen wayland-extension repository. The two interfaces are in one protocol file so wayland-scanner can resolve the cross- interface `wtz_surface.screen` reference in a single pass.

interface.name: wtz_screen
interface.description: Trimmed: only the bits referenced by `wtz_surface.screen`. Full protocol (size/name events, splitscreen requests, …) lives in upstream `wtz-screen.xml`; not needed for window creation.

interface.name: wtz_shell
interface.description: wtz_shell allows clients to turn a wl_surface into a wtz_surface which can support the Tizen features in Tizen Display Server.

request.name: get_wtz_surface

description.summary: create a tizen shell surface from a surface

request.description: This creates a wtz_surface for the given surface.

interface.name: wtz_surface
interface.description: An interface that may be implemented by a wl_surface, for implementations that provide a tizen-specific user interface.

description.summary: tizen screen which this surface locates
